name: netatalk-uam-random-short-read
fixed_note: afpd: harden uam_random_string: the AFP authentication nonce was filled with a single read() of /dev/urandom checked only with `ret <= 0`, so a short read left part of the nonce unset; the fix loops until the buffer is full.
setup: : > config.h && meson subprojects download bstring && ln -sfn "$(ls -d subprojects/bstring-*/bstring | head -n 1)" bstring-include
args_note: meson defines _U_ and NO_DDP; iniparser.h comes from libiniparser-dev, bstrlib.h from the bstring subproject (fetched by its wrap; the version differs between commits)

fixed: ^        int ret = read\(fd, buf \+ done, len - done\);$
